data.name: ESMO: Esports Manager Online
data.detailed_description:
ESMO: Esports Manager Online is an online management sim where your decisions turn into matches you can watch. Build a persistent club across three games (a MOBA, a Tactical Shooter, and Car Soccer), recruit and develop players, work the live transfer market, and compete against real managers around the world.

Watch the Match, Not a Results Table

Set the plan, then watch it play out in a live viewer. The MOBA uses a top-down 2D match view; the Tactical Shooter and Car Soccer render in 3D. Read rotations, fights, retakes, drafts, and objective calls as they happen, then adjust the next plan with detailed match reports and spectating.

One Account, Every Platform

Play on PC, iOS, and Android with a single account and one persistent club. Your progress follows you to every device, and you compete against real managers on all platforms in the same global ecosystem.

Build a Persistent Club

- Create your club, name it, and choose the nation it represents.

- Field separate rosters for the MOBA, the Tactical Shooter, and Car Soccer.

- Manage finances and debt, or wipe the slate clean with a Fresh Start.

- Scout rival clubs worldwide: players, finances, and contract history.

Scout, Sign, and Develop Players

- Every player has a nickname, age, nationality, potential, morale, a distinct personality, and 16 rated attributes from Accuracy to Vision.

- Negotiate wages, contract length, prize-money split, and release fees.

- Develop players through training XP, champion mastery, and focused tasks: replay analysis, solo-queue sessions, and scouting.

- Match each player's strengths to the right role so your roster fits the game plan.

Work the Transfer Market

- Search a global player database, or list your own players for sale.

- Bid in real time during timed 2-hour sale windows and outmaneuver rival managers.

- Weigh prices, timing, and withdrawal fees before you commit.

Compete in Named Circuits

- Enter the daily open City Circuit, the regional Weekend Prestige Circuit across AMER, APAC, and EMEA, the ongoing Regional Weekly League, quick matches, and friendlies.

- Play Swiss, single elimination, and group-stage formats.

- Reach the Masters and Major tiers at the top of the Weekend Prestige Circuit.

- Climb the 9-tier ranked ladder from Iron to Elite, with placement matches, a Points Shield, and Rank Decay.

- Meet roster residency requirements, or risk a forfeit.

Command Deep In-Match Tactics

The MOBA and the Tactical Shooter each come with a full tactical toolkit.

[h3]Tactical Shooter[/h3]

- Build playbooks and appoint an in-game leader (IGL).

- Choose buy strategies from eco to full buy, then prepare bomb defenses and retakes.

- Assign go-to, hold, peek, and throw tasks with tempos and synchronization points.

- Track K/D, ADR, and HS%.

[h3]MOBA[/h3]

- Manage hero pools and navigate pick-and-ban drafts.

- Adjust live tactics, set wave management to push or freeze, and coordinate ganks.

- Track the gold difference and secure objectives.

[h3]Car Soccer[/h3]

Car Soccer rounds out ESMO's three games. Build a roster, set your team tactics, and watch every match play out in a 3D live viewer.

Grow as a Manager

- Earn XP, level up, and unlock talents on a manager talent tree that reshapes how you play.

- Reset your build free after every major update, so nothing is ever locked in.

A Living Game and Community

- ESMO is updated regularly with new features, balance changes, and quality-of-life improvements shaped by player feedback.

- Join an active Discord community for patch notes, trades, feedback, and support.

Build the club, make the calls, and watch the match tell you if they worked.

data.short_description: Watch every match play out live as you run a persistent esports club across a MOBA, a Tactical Shooter, and Car Soccer. Scout and develop players, work a live transfer market, and climb from Iron to Elite against real managers worldwide, with cross-play across PC, iOS, and Android.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL 3.3+ support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires an active broadband internet connection for online multiplayer.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection required.
